source: nflverse play-by-play 1999-2025, nflverse schedules (games.csv) 1999-2025, nfldata standings 2002+ and win totals, nflverse trades 2002+, FiveThirtyEight nfl_games.csv for 1996-1998 scores
note: Regular seasons unless a key says playoffs. Per team game means each team's game counts once (two per game).

penalty_kinds_per_team_game.note: accepted penalties, the 20 most common kinds

weather_splits.years: 1999-2025, outdoor and open-roof games with a reading (about 77% of them)

champions.years: 1996-2025 (team codes as in nflverse; 1996-1998 FiveThirtyEight codes)

parity.years: 1999-2025 for team records; 1996-2025 for champions; standings from 2002

head_coaches.years: 1999-2025 (who coached each regular-season game; a change is any new head coach, fired, resigned or retired)

trades.years: 2002-2025 (nflverse trades, from Pro Football Reference and news)
